text: Zara starts at the architecture firm on November 3rd. She's excited but says the commute is going to be brutal. Text her that morning to wish her luck.
Neha's birthday is December 9. She's been obsessed with pottery since the summer and mentioned wanting a proper set of glaze brushes.

Lunch with Delroy. He's retiring at the end of January after thirty-one years with the council. His wife Esther is planning a surprise party for the weekend after, probably February 7th. She wants old colleagues there, so I said I'd dig out numbers for Ann and Reggie from the planning team. Delroy has no idea, and he's already talking about taking up fly fishing and finally fixing up the allotment.

Ming has a second interview at the bank on Thursday. She sounded really nervous on the phone, said she blanked on a question last time. I should call her the day before and run through some practice questions. It's for the analyst role she's wanted since uni, and her mum keeps asking about it, which isn't helping. She's going to stay at her brother Idris's flat the night before because it's closer to Canary Wharf.
Emil got the promotion! Senior engineer from 11/1. Don't forget to send him a congratulations card.
Abigail mentioned her dad turns seventy on March 2nd. They're doing a family meal at the Italian place on the high street.
Dentist moved to Tuesday at 4. Pick up the dry cleaning on the way back.
Farid applied for the logistics manager role at Andersson Freight. He hears back in about two weeks. Ask him how it went once he's heard.
Lucy is leaving the bakery on Friday. Leaving drinks at the Crown afterwards, and I said I'd go.
Cem loves vintage film cameras. Already has three Olympus bodies. Worth remembering for his birthday in July.

Talked to Reggie after church. His daughter Mila just got offered a graduate scheme place in Leeds, starting September 8th. He's thrilled but already missing her. She's looking at flats near Headingley and wants to drive up the weekend before to view a few. Reggie offered to take the van. Her birthday is August 21st, so maybe something for the new place would go down well, like a decent set of pans.
Svetlana has been struggling since the restructure. Her manager left and she's now covering two jobs. Need to check in with her next week.
Idris's interview with the NHS trust got cancelled; they've frozen hiring. He's going to keep applying elsewhere.
Liam and Tamar are both starting new jobs on the same day, June 3rd. Silly coincidence. Celebratory dinner at theirs the Saturday after.

Kevin's mum is having her retirement do on April 18. He asked if I could help with the slideshow. I'm doing the music for it already. She worked at the post office for thirty-eight years and wants Motown all night. Kevin's worried his speech will be too emotional, so he's going to send me a draft the week before.
Obi says his brother Tendai has finally finished his apprenticeship and starts full time at the garage on Monday.
Esther hinted, not subtly, that she'd love a new Kindle for her birthday. Hers has a cracked screen.
Fiona's first day as deputy head was yesterday. She said it was chaotic but good. Text her at the end of the week to see how the first week went.
Miriam doesn't drink, so maybe skip the wine for her birthday on 8/22. She's into board games and has been eyeing Wingspan.
Tomás is applying for a PhD in Edinburgh. Deadline is January 15th. Remind me to send him the reference letter the week before.
Ann's grandson Elijah turns five on Saturday. He's mad about dinosaurs, especially anything with a stegosaurus.
Rin had her final round interview with Nakamura Design this morning. She thinks it went well. They'll call her by Friday. I must message her Friday evening.
Rana told me she's handing in her notice tomorrow. Her boss has no idea. She's been offered a role in Manchester and starts on May 14.
Ali's dog Biscuit is turning one next week. He's genuinely planning a cake. He also mentioned his new job at the vet's starts the day after.
Dafydd Williams, Daf to everyone at work, is retiring on October 31st. Collection going round for a gift. Chip in a tenner before Wednesday.
Demi is really anxious about her driving test on the 28th. Third attempt. Wish her luck the night before and ask how it went the next day.
Anya told me she's starting a pastry course in the evenings. Wants to open her own café one day.
Haircut booked for Saturday morning, then I'm driving to Mum's.

Coffee with Zara and her sister Rana. Rana's just got engaged to Kevin; the wedding is next summer. Zara's maid of honour and already stressing about the hen do. Rana wants something low-key in the Lake District, but Zara's budget is tight since she's only just started the new job. I need to ask Zara what dates she's thinking so I can book the time off.

Neha's husband Farid is going for a promotion to head of department. Panel interview on February 6th. She says he's barely sleeping. Give him a ring the day before to calm his nerves, and maybe take them both out for dinner a week after, whatever happens.
Delroy says his grandson Obi got into Imperial for engineering. Starts in the autumn.
Mila loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli. Has the posters, the soundtrack vinyls, the lot. Her birthday's June 17th.
Mrs Fischer next door is leaving the library after twenty years. Her last day is Thursday. I should get her a card and some flowers.
Cem didn't get the job at Zhou & Baker. He was gutted; he'd done four rounds. Says he needs a break from applying for a while.
Idris starts at the new school on 9/2, teaching year six. He's nervous about meeting the parents. Check in with him afterwards.

Long chat with Tendai. He's been made redundant from the warehouse, effective the end of the month. He's okay-ish, says it was coming. He has an interview at the depot in Croydon on December 4th and another one with the council the week after. His partner Lucy is pregnant, due in March, so the timing is awful. I need to send him the job listing I saw at Obi's firm, and call him the evening after the first interview to hear how it went.
Ming's birthday dinner on Friday has been called off; her grandma's in hospital. She's flying to Shanghai on Sunday instead.
Reminder: Uncle Reggie's seventy-fifth is on May 3. Everyone's meeting at the cricket club. Order the cake by April 20th.
Esther and Delroy are celebrating forty years married on July 12th. They're renewing their vows in the garden.
Abigail's starting at the hospital as a staff nurse in two weeks. She's moved into a flat near the station.
Tamar is vegan and allergic to sesame. Keep that in mind for her leaving lunch on Wednesday.
Svetlana's son is applying for apprenticeships. He has an assessment day at Rolls-Royce on March 11th. She asked if I could look over his CV beforehand.
Emil mentioned he's been learning Japanese for a year now. Wants to work in Tokyo eventually.
Fiona told me her husband got the redundancy letter last week. They're fine for money for now, but she's worried. Their eldest starts uni in September.
Liam turns forty on August 30. He's into cycling and keeps talking about a new GPS bike computer. Maybe go in with Tamar on it.
Spoke to Dr Tanaka about the reference. She's happy to write one but needs my CV by Monday.
Kevin got the call: he's the new store manager from next month. Massive. Send him a bottle of something.

Obi's sister Miriam has her interview for the paramedic training programme on April 2nd. Fitness test the same morning, interview that afternoon, results a week after. She's been training for months, running every morning before her shifts at the call centre. Obi is driving her there and waiting around all day. Remember to text her good luck the night before and ask Obi how it went afterwards.
Rin's flatmate Ann just started at a law firm. Long hours already. Rin says Ann barely sees daylight.
Elijah's first day at the new job went well. He said everyone was friendly, and his manager took him for lunch. He's in the London office Mondays and Thursdays.
Must renew passport before the Lisbon trip in March.
Tomás has a cat called Pimiento, who apparently shreds every card he gets. Ha.

Ali's leaving do is the Friday after his last day, so November 14th. He's moving to a start-up in Bristol. Book the table at Nando's for twelve, and ask Zara if she can bring the card round for everyone to sign the day before.

Lucy said Demi is applying for jobs in Dublin. She's had two video interviews and has one in person on 12/10. Demi's been feeling low about the whole thing. She thinks the last panel didn't like her, and she's been out of work since the summer. Lucy wants us both to take her out for a drink after the interview, whatever the outcome. I should message Demi this week just to see how she's doing.
Picked up the present for Neha. Wrap it tonight.
Anya's partner Cem has his annual review on Friday. If it goes well he might get the team lead role. He seemed pretty calm about it.
Farid mentioned his mum just retired from teaching. She's already booked a cruise for the spring.
Dafydd's daughter has her graduation on July 9th, and he's taking the whole week off afterwards. Remind me to message him congrats that day.
Mila got the internship at the Tate! Starts the Monday after her exams finish. Proud of her.
Nothing major from the call with Svetlana. She's well, and the kids are fine.
